title: focuser_primaluce abort did not end a SESTO SENSO 3 calibration run
summary: Abort sent the ordinary motor stop; according to the SESTO SENSO 3 protocol document v1.0 the semi-automatic run ends only with CAL_FOCUSER StopMotor (stop_calib leaves the procedure).

resolution.evidence: 011-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: abort sends StopMotor and stop_calib and publishes the focuser uncalibrated; sestosenso3_calibration_restart passes against a simulator that ignores the ordinary stop; not exercised on hardware.
